expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.U===12 && S.R1===4 && S.R2===8 && S.kytkenta==='sarja' && S.t===0 && S.T1===20 && S.T2===20 && S.running===false ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: U = 12 V, R1 = 4 ohm, R2 = 8 ohm in series, clock stopped at 0 s, both beakers 20,0 C (must run before any setup)
on load, series: I (lesson-answers sarja-I)
on load, series: U1 (lesson-answers sarja-U1)
on load, series: U2 (lesson-answers sarja-U2)
on load, series: P1 (lesson-answers sarja-P1)
on load, series: P2 (lesson-answers sarja-P2)
on load, series: P (lesson-answers sarja-P)
on load: P1 + P2 = U I

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const ok=(r,a,b,s)=>r.min===a&&r.max===b&&r.step===s; return R.length===3 && ok(R[0],'1','12','0.5') && ok(R[1],'2','20','1') && ok(R[2],'2','20','1') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three sliders: U 1-12 V by 0,5; R1 and R2 2-20 ohm by 1
selects: connection series/parallel, speed 5/15/60 simulated s per s

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Käynnistä' && b[1]==='Nollaa' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='R1,R2,U,kytkenta' && P.U.unit==='V' && P.R2.unit==='Ω' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares U (V), R1 and R2 (ohm) and the connection

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?660:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x660 (larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows the voltages and the powers
